inspiration: RE-friction need mach-o-objc-msgsend; Ghidra Mach-O external-reference import-slot modelling
decisions: Extend the existing peimportcall compatibility gate rather than add a sibling option: PE IAT and Mach-O typed import-pointer calls reach the same ActionDeindirect external-reference decision, and option off restores the anonymous rendering on either format.

Preserve the complete Mach-O import inventory. The common indirect-symbol walk returns a second product containing only exact pointer-width S_LAZY_SYMBOL_POINTERS and S_NON_LAZY_SYMBOL_POINTERS ranges; stubs and exports stay named but are never painted.

Reject LOCAL/ABS indirect entries, invalid symbols, empty names and address overflow before adding a range. Lazy-dylib/TLS pointer classes and ordinary data such as __objc_msgrefs remain naming-only or unvisited.
Keep the upstream Win32 no-return list structurally inside the PE/COFF arm. Mach-O receives only externref ranges, so Windows-specific names cannot cross formats.

Update typed-mach-o-tail's regression pins from the deliberately superseded raw-slot spelling to the same argument-preservation contract under the imported name; the fixture still proves fmt and value survive, while the new two-pass tests pin the raw off arm.

acceptance.result: PASS: 7 raw dat_100004038 calls become 7 objc_msgSend calls; dat_100004038 absent
acceptance.negative_control: both calls through __objc_msgrefs word dat_100004d60 remain raw

regression_sweep.dataset_witness: 50 functions in both arms, 0 errors, 27 changed bodies: 20 application functions with 40 exact dat_100004038-to-objc_msgSend bindings plus 7 named import veneers; dat_100004d60 occurrences 4 -> 4
regression_sweep.vendored_macho: 12 images across x86-64, arm64, fat, arm64e and object files; identical function/error sets; 5 byte-identical, 7 changing one import-veneer body each (or the new _call_slots body), every hunk an imported name binding
